name: Labor Almanac
description: An open, versioned index of public labor and employment data.

entries.title: ABS Labour Force, Australia
entries.description: The Australian Bureau of Statistics' monthly headline labour market release from the Labour Force Survey: employment, unemployment, underemployment, participation and hours worked, nationally and by state and territory, in original, seasonally adjusted and trend terms.
entries.attribution: Source: Australian Bureau of Statistics, Labour Force, Australia, <reference period>
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200, page "Labour Force, Australia, September 2026", "Headline estimates of employment, unemployment, underemployment, participation and hours worked from the monthly Labour Force Survey", released 15/10/2026. It reports that seasonally adjusted "the unemployment rate increased 0.1ppt to 4.7%" and notes that the September 2026 release "marks the return to the full suite of Labour Force data products" after the Labour Force Modernisation. The page has "Data downloads" sections; the spreadsheet format is assumed and wasn't opened. The ABS Data API and the series start years weren't checked.
Licence checked 2026-10-31: the ABS copyright page (https://www.abs.gov.au/website-privacy-copyright-and-disclaimer) says "All material presented on this website is provided under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence, with the exception of: the Commonwealth Coat of Arms, the ABS logo" and some other items. This is a site-wide statement that covers the data downloads. The attribution string follows the ABS's general guidance ("Attributing ABS material"), which wasn't opened.

entries.title: ILOSTAT — ILO Labour Statistics Database
entries.description: The International Labour Organization's global labour statistics database: employment, unemployment, labour force, wages, working time, labour income, informality, occupational safety and labour-related SDG indicators, compiled from national sources and ILO modelled estimates for more than 200 countries and territories.

coverage.spatial: global (200+ countries and territories, plus regional and income-group aggregates)

entries.license: CC-BY-4.0 (ILO Rights and permissions, data published as of 3 May 2023)
entries.notes:
Human-verified 2026-10-31: HTTP 200 for the ILOSTAT API documentation (titled "ILOSTAT API", "Simple, comprehensive and direct access to ILOSTAT data", with examples for browser, R, Python, Stata and SAS). The main ILOSTAT portal (https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/) answered HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare "Just a moment..." challenge to curl, headless Chromium and WebFetch alike, so this entry catalogs the ILO-run API host; a curator may prefer to switch canonical_url back to the portal once it can be verified. On the same host, the ILOSTAT Bulk Download page (https://rplumber.ilo.org/files/website/bulk/indicator.html) showed "Last update: 2026-10-30" and lists .csv, .csv.gz, .dta, .feather, .rds, .parquet, .tsv and .json files, and a sample API call (unemployment rate, Canada, CSV) returned HTTP 200. ILO's own www.ilo.org/data-and-statistics page (HTTP 200) calls ILOSTAT "The world's leading source of labour statistics" with "300 million+ data points freely accessible".
Licence checked 2026-10-31: ILO Rights and permissions (https://www.ilo.org/rights-and-permissions, redirected from the API's "Copyright & permissions" link) says "As of 3 May 2023, databases and datasets together with the accompanying referential metadata are covered by the Creative Commons CC BY 4.0 licence. This licence does not apply to microdata submitted by or obtained from constituents and partner institutions that is restricted solely to the ILO's use." Data published before that date "do not automatically benefit from a Creative Commons licence". The ILOSTAT-specific terms page and citation format on ilostat.ilo.org could not be read (Cloudflare). Indicator coverage, start years and the cadence were not checked.
